title: Valid palindrome
summary: Return true if `text` reads the same in both directions, ignoring case and anything that is not a letter or digit.
hints: To check a palindrome by hand you compare two characters at a time. Which two do you start with, and where do you go next?
Use two positions, one at each end, moving towards each other. Skip any character that is not a letter or digit before comparing.
While left < right: move left forward past characters to skip, move right back past characters to skip, compare the two in lowercase, then step both inward.
takeaway: Two pointers check the string in place: O(n) time and no extra memory. Building a cleaned copy and comparing it with its reverse also works and is easier to write under pressure.
